z: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.
To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.
Shroodle protects itself from foes using both its poisonous saliva and its front teeth, which are disproportionately big and long for its small body.
